fields.label: About Body
fields.text_en: Pokhara Research Center (PRC), is a not-profit distributing company registered in the year 2019. PRC defies itself as a public policy research institute with the aspiration of developing into a leading thinktank and an institution of excellence in Nepal. The centre was established as a unique response to the changing political climate in Nepal. Through research, public dialogue, and collaboration, PRC brings evidence and diverse perspectives into policy discussions. Its work focuses on strengthening accountable governance and connecting citizens, policymakers, and institutions.
fields.text_np: पोखरा रिसर्च सेन्टरले नेपालमा अग्रणी थिङ्क ट्याङ्कका रूपमा विकास हुने लक्ष्यसहित आफूलाई सार्वजनिक नीतिगत अनुसन्धान संस्थाका रूपमा परिभाषित गरेको छ। नेपालको परिवर्तनशील राजनीतिक परिवेशबाट उत्पन्न आवश्यकता र चुनौतीहरूको सुसंगत प्रक्रिया स्वरूपमा यस सेन्टरको स्थापना गरिएको हो। अनुसन्धान, सार्वजनिक संवाद र सहकार्यमार्फत PRC ले नीतिगत छलफलमा प्रमाण र विविध दृष्टिकोण समेट्ने काम गर्छ। जवाफदेही शासनलाई सुदृढ बनाउनु र नागरिक, नीति निर्माता तथा संस्थाहरूबीच सम्बन्ध जोड्नु यसको कामको मुख्य उद्देश्य हो।

fields.label: Mission Body
fields.text_en: In December 2017, two years after the promulgation of the current constitution, Sujan Regmi, the founder of the company, recognising the gap in development policy in Nepal and realizing the rights bestowed by the constitution began the incubation exercise. This led to the creation of the first cell namely, Institution cell with the objective of formulating the center's identity, public profile, processes and stakeholder relations.
fields.text_np: नेपाल तथा विश्वस्तरमा उत्कृष्ट अनुसंन्धान कम्पनीका रूपमा पोखरा रिसर्च सेन्टर लाई स्थापित गर्नु यस सेलको मुख्य उद्देश्य हो। उच्च गुणस्तरको, प्रमाण–आधारित अनुसन्धान तथा कार्यान्वयनयोग्य नीतिगत सिफारिसहरू उत्पादन गर्दै लोकतान्त्रिक शासन प्रणालीलाई सुदृढ बनाउने, सार्वजनिक क्षेत्रको कार्यसम्पादन सुधार गर्ने, निजी उद्यमलाई प्रवर्द्धन गर्ने तथा समावेशी सामाजिक–आर्थिक विकासमा योगदान पुर्‍याउने यस सेलको लक्ष्य हो। गहन विश्लेषण र विश्वसनीय ज्ञान उत्पादनमार्फत यस सेलले सक्षम सार्वजनिक संस्था निर्माण र सचेत मतदाता तयार पार्न सहयोग पुर्‍याउँछ, साथै गुणस्तरीय रोजगारी सिर्जनामा योगदान गर्दछ।

fields.label: Mission Body 1
fields.text_en: In 2019, PRC was formally registered in its namesake Pokhara Metropolitan City in Kaski district of Gandaki Province. The YO Strategic Directive led by the Institution Cell, was enacted to create the first project cell namely, Province Cell with the mission to promote economic freedom of the individual through good governance in the provinces.
fields.text_np: पोखरा रिसर्च सेन्टरको 'प्रदेश सेल'ले अनुसन्धान, नीति विश्लेषण र सरोकारवालासँगको संवादमार्फत प्रादेशिक स्वायत्तताको पक्षपोषण गर्दै नेपालमा विकेन्द्रीकृत, समावेशी र उत्तरदायी शासन प्रणालीको प्रवर्द्धन गर्दछ। स्थानीय स्तरका समाधानद्वारा निर्देशित दिगो विकास र पारदर्शी नीतिगत प्रणाली सुनिश्चित गर्न यो सेलले स्थानीय संस्थाहरू एवं नागरिकको सशक्तीकरणमा जोड दिन्छ।

fields.label: Mission Body 2
fields.text_en: The primary objective of the Province cell is to reduce excessive centralization in Nepal and enhance provincial autonomy with the aim to bring the government closer to citizens. The Province Cell dissects its work in three wings pursuant to the three facets of provincial governance in Nepal, namely, Province Assembly (inc. 2019), Province Government (inc. 2021) and Intergovernmental Relations (inc. 2023).
fields.text_np: प्रदेश सेलको प्रमुख उद्देश्य नेपालमा अत्यधिक केन्द्रीकरण घटाउने र प्रादेशिक स्वायत्तता बढाउने हो, जसले सरकारलाई नागरिकसँग नजिक ल्याउँछ। प्रदेश सेलले आफ्नो कामलाई नेपालको प्रादेशिक शासनका तीन पक्षअनुसार तीन विभागमा विभाजन गर्छ, अर्थात् प्रदेश सभा (स्था. २०१९), प्रदेश सरकार (स्था. २०२१) र अन्तर–सरकारी सम्बन्ध (स्था. २०२३)।

fields.label: Mission Body
fields.text_en: In September 2025, witnessing the "Gen-Z Protests" in the country and releasing the gap in public knowledge on constitutional freedoms and rights, the Institution cell created the Constitution Cell with the aim of creating a well informed electorate through periodic citizen engagement deliverables in a series of events celebrating the freedoms of the Nepalese Constitution annually.
fields.text_np: नवीन कार्यक्रम, अनुभवजन्य अनुसन्धान तथा रणनीतिक ज्ञान प्रसारमार्फत राजनीतिक तथा संवैधानिक प्रक्रियामा नागरिकको अर्थपूर्ण सहभागिता विस्तार गर्नु यस सेलको उद्देश्य हो। समावेशी सहभागिताका अवसरहरू सिर्जना गर्दै नागरिकलाई नीति निर्माण प्रक्रिया बुझ्न, प्रभाव पार्न र सह–निर्माण गर्न सक्षम बनाइन्छ। यस सेलले नागरिकहरू आफ्ना जीवनमा प्रत्यक्ष प्रभाव पार्ने निर्णयहरूमा सक्रिय भूमिका खेल्ने, सूचित, संलग्न र सहकार्यपूर्ण नागरिक संस्कृतिको विकास गर्दै लोकतान्त्रिक शासन प्रणालीलाई सुदृढ बनाउन प्रतिबद्धता जनाउँछ।

fields.label: About Body
fields.text_en: Our flagship fellowship that equips young Nepali leaders with the skills, exposure, and mentoring to engage with provincial policy. Across multiple cohorts, fellows gain hands-on research experience, take part in youth assemblies, and work directly with lawmakers — building a pipeline of informed, capable leaders for stronger provincial governance.
fields.text_np: हाम्रो प्रमुख फेलोसिप कार्यक्रम, जसले युवा नेपाली नेतृत्वकर्ताहरूलाई प्रदेश नीतिमा सहभागी हुनका लागि सीप, अभ्यास र मार्गदर्शन प्रदान गर्दछ। विभिन्न समूहहरूमा फेलोहरूले व्यावहारिक अनुसन्धान अनुभव प्राप्त गर्छन्, युवा सभाहरूमा भाग लिन्छन् र प्रत्यक्ष रूपमा विधायकहरूसँग काम गर्छन् — सुदृढ प्रादेशिक सुशासनका लागि जानकार र सक्षम नेतृत्वकर्ताहरूको शृङ्खला निर्माण गर्दै।

fields.label: Tagline
fields.text_en: A public policy research institute based in Pokhara, working to inform discourse and shape debate for accountable governance in Gandaki Province and beyond.
fields.text_np: पोखरामा आधारित सार्वजनिक नीति अनुसन्धान संस्था, गण्डकी प्रदेश र त्यसबाहिर जवाफदेही शासनका लागि संवादलाई सूचित र बहसलाई आकार दिन काम गर्दै।

fields.label: About Heading
fields.text_en: Youth In Policy & Governance (YPG) Fellowship Program
fields.text_np: नीति तथा सुशासनमा युवा (वाईपीजी) फेलोसिप कार्यक्रम

fields.label: Mission Body
fields.text_en: Our mission is to strengthen Nepal's federalism by promoting provincial autonomy, reducing centralization, and informing citizens through research, programs, and strategic communication.
fields.text_np: हाम्रो उद्देश्य प्रादेशिक स्वायत्तता प्रवर्द्धन, केन्द्रीकरण न्यूनीकरण, र अनुसन्धान, कार्यक्रम तथा रणनीतिक सञ्चारमार्फत नागरिकलाई सूचित गर्दै नेपालको संघीयतालाई सुदृढ बनाउनु हो।

fields.label: Vision Body
fields.text_en: A democratic Nepal with empowered subnational governments and a well-informed electorate.
fields.text_np: सशक्त उपराष्ट्रिय सरकारहरू र सुसूचित मतदाता वर्ग भएको लोकतान्त्रिक नेपाल।

fields.label: Objective 1
fields.text_en: Independence and Integrity: Nonpartisan, financially and intellectually autonomous, and transparent and ethical in all our work.
fields.text_np: स्वतन्त्रता र निष्ठा: गैरदलीय, आर्थिक तथा बौद्धिक रूपमा स्वायत्त, र आफ्ना सबै कार्यमा पारदर्शी तथा नैतिक रहने।

fields.label: Objective 2
fields.text_en: Rigor and Innovation: Sound methods, credible evidence, and thorough review, paired with sustainable, forward-looking approaches to delivering our mission.
fields.text_np: गहनता र नवप्रवर्तन: विश्वसनीय प्रमाण, सुदृढ विधि र गहन समीक्षाका साथै दिगो तथा दूरदर्शी दृष्टिकोण अपनाउने।

fields.label: Objective 3
fields.text_en: Public Benefit: Research and capacity-building that fill knowledge gaps and inform the public on current issues.
fields.text_np: सार्वजनिक हित: अनुसन्धान तथा क्षमता विकासमार्फत विद्यमान ज्ञानका रिक्तता पूरा गर्ने र समसामयिक विषयमा जनतालाई सूचित गर्ने।

fields.label: Objective 4
fields.text_en: Inclusivity: Gender parity in participation and positions of authority.
fields.text_np: समावेशिता: सहभागिता तथा नेतृत्वदायी पदहरूमा लैङ्गिक समानता सुनिश्चित गर्ने।

fields.label: Objective 5
fields.text_en: Collaboration: Constructive partnerships with government, civil society, academia, and development partners, both nationally and internationally.
fields.text_np: सहकार्य: राष्ट्रिय तथा अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय स्तरमा सरकार, नागरिक समाज, प्राज्ञिक क्षेत्र र विकास साझेदारहरूसँग रचनात्मक साझेदारी गर्ने।

fields.bio_en: Sujan leads PRC as its Executive Director. Since PRC’s inception, he has been instrumental in informing debate and shaping dialogue on the state of public policy implementation in Nepal. He directs the Programs and Outreach Divisions of the company designing and executing format based dialogue and consultation series with elected representatives across four Provincial Assemblies as well as running youth skill development programs to train future public leaders.
fields.bio_np: सुजन रेग्मीले पोखरा रिसर्च सेन्टरको कार्यकारी निर्देशकको रूपमा नेतृत्व प्रदान गर्दै आएका छन्। सेन्टरको स्थापनाकालदेखि नै उनले नेपालमा सार्वजनिक नीति कार्यान्वयनको अवस्थाबारे सार्थक बहस र संरचित संवाद निर्माणमा महत्वपूर्ण भूमिका खेलेका छन्। उनको नेतृत्वमा कार्यक्रम तथा पहुँच (Programs and Outreach) विभाग सञ्चालन हुँदै आएको छ, जसअन्तर्गत नेपालका चारवटा प्रदेश सभामा निर्वाचित जनप्रतिनिधिहरूसँग प्रारूप–आधारित संवाद तथा परामर्श शृंखलाहरू डिजाइन र कार्यान्वयन गरिन्छ। साथै, उनले भविष्यका सार्वजनिक नेतृत्व निर्माण गर्ने उद्देश्यले युवा सीप विकास तथा क्षमता अभिवृद्धि कार्यक्रमहरूको पनि नेतृत्व गर्छन्।

fields.bio_en: Kuldeep Niraula, Ph.D. in Conflict Analysis and Resolution from George Mason University’s Carter School for Peace and Conflict Resolution, USA, serves as a Research Advisor at Pokhara Research Centre, advising on the centre’s research agenda and publications. He contributes to the development of research proposals and provides technical inputs to ongoing research projects. He also proactively contributes to institutional narrative writing, working both independently and collaboratively with the research team.
fields.bio_np: डा. कुलदीप निरौला (जर्ज मेसन युनिभर्सिटी, कार्टर स्कुल फर पिस एन्ड कन्फ्लिक्ट रिजोलुसन, अमेरिका, द्वन्द्व विश्लेषण तथा समाधानमा विद्यावारिधि), पोखरा रिसर्च सेन्टरमा अनुसन्धान सल्लाहकारका रूपमा कार्यरत हुनुहुन्छ। उहाँले केन्द्रको अनुसन्धान तथा प्रकाशनसम्बन्धी कार्यमा सल्लाह दिनुका साथै अनुसन्धान प्रस्ताव तयार गर्न र अनुसन्धान परियोजनाहरूमा प्राविधिक सहयोग प्रदान गर्नुहुन्छ। साथै, उहाँ संस्थागत लेखनमा पनि सक्रिय रूपमा संलग्न रहँदै अनुसन्धान टिमसँग स्वतन्त्र तथा सहकार्यात्मक रूपमा कार्य गर्नुहुन्छ।

fields.bio_en: Annapurna manages the Kitchen and Housekeeping duties of the Centre ensuring an enabling environment for its employees and visitors. She is also responsible for procurement, preparation, budgeting and reporting for the Kitchen providing a hearty home cooked Nepali lunch for twelve to twenty five people on any given day.
fields.bio_np: अन्नपूर्णा अधिकारीले केन्द्रको भान्सा तथा हाउसकिपिङ व्यवस्थापन गर्दै कर्मचारी तथा आगन्तुकका लागि सुरक्षित, स्वच्छ र सहयोगी कार्य–वातावरण सुनिश्चित गर्छिन्। उनी भान्सासम्बन्धी खरिद, तयारी, बजेट निर्माण तथा प्रतिवेदनको जिम्मेवारी सम्हाल्दै दैनिक रूपमा १२ देखि २५ जनासम्मका लागि घरायसी नेपाली भोजन व्यवस्थापन गर्छिन्।

fields.bio_en: Monika advises the Institution Cell on the various products, programs and projects of the centre’s mission-based cells with a special focus on gender parity initiatives in the workplace. As a research advisor she also facilitates policy research on provincial affairs, public policy and institutional reform.
fields.bio_np: मोनिकाले सेन्टरको मिसन–आधारित सेलहरूका विभिन्न उत्पादन, कार्यक्रम र परियोजनाहरूका सम्बन्धमा संस्थागत सेल (Institution Cell) लाई सल्लाह प्रदान गर्दछिन्। यसमा कार्यस्थलमा लैंगिक समानता कायम गर्ने पहलहरूमा उनको विशेष जोड रहने गर्दछ। अनुसन्धान सल्लाहकारको रूपमा उनले प्रादेशिक मामिला, सार्वजनिक नीति र संस्थागत सुधारका क्षेत्रमा हुने नीतिगत अनुसन्धानमा समेत सहजीकरण गर्दछिन्।

fields.bio_en: Saurab Wagle serves as the Manager, Finance at Pokhara Research Centre. He oversees the Centre’s overall financial management, including budgeting, accounting, financial records, and documentation. He also manages the financial aspects of the Centre’s programmes and activities and supports administrative coordination and effective use of resources.
fields.bio_np: सौरब वाग्ले सेन्टरमा वित्त प्रबन्धक का रूपमा कार्यरत छन्। उनले सेन्टरको समग्र वित्तीय व्यवस्थापनअन्तर्गत बजेट, लेखा, वित्तीय अभिलेख तथा कागजात व्यवस्थापन गर्छन्। साथै, उनी सेन्टरका कार्यक्रम तथा गतिविधिहरूको वित्तीय व्यवस्थापन, प्रशासनिक समन्वय तथा स्रोत–साधनको प्रभावकारी उपयोग सुनिश्चित गर्न सक्रिय रूपमा संलग्न छन्।

fields.bio_en: Shree is the Communication Associate for the Province Cell, overseeing product development and the execution of key programs. He leads the efforts of the center’s Nepali Language Committee, focusing on grassroots outreach and effective community engagement fostering policy partnerships to strengthen communication between the center and its diverse stakeholders.
fields.bio_np: श्रीकृष्ण ध्वज बस्नेत प्रदेश र संविधान सेलसँग आबद्ध सञ्चार सहयोगी हुन्, जसले सेन्टरका नीति-आधारित उत्पादन विकास र कार्यक्रम कार्यान्वयनमा सक्रिय योगदान पुर्‍याउँछन्। उनी सेन्टरको नेपाली भाषा समितिको नेतृत्व गर्दै स्थानीय तहसम्म प्रभावकारी सञ्चार र नीतिगत संवादलाई अघि बढाउँछन्। यस भूमिकामा उनले सेन्टर र विभिन्न सरोकारवालाहरूबीच रणनीतिक साझेदारी प्रवर्द्धन गर्न विशेष जोड दिन्छन्।

fields.bio_en: Suyasha coordinates the engagement activities for the centre’s Province Cell’s stakeholders. She translates data driven research into communication briefs and outreach material enabling decisive policy dialogue and fostering inclusive participation across the execution of its programs. She also contributes towards the development of knowledge products for elected representatives in provincial assemblies.
fields.bio_np: सुयशा पुनले सेन्टरको प्रदेश कोषिकासँग सम्बन्धित सरोकारवालासँगको संलग्नता तथा पहुँच गतिविधिहरूको समन्वय गर्छिन्। उनी डेटा–आधारित अनुसन्धानलाई नीतिगत सञ्चार सामग्री, संक्षेप (Briefs) र पहुँच सामग्रीमा रूपान्तरण गर्दै प्रभावकारी नीति संवाद र समावेशी सहभागिता सुनिश्चित गर्छिन्। साथै, प्रदेश सभाका निर्वाचित प्रतिनिधिहरूका लागि ज्ञान–आधारित सामग्री विकासमा पनि योगदान पुर्‍याउँछिन्।

fields.bio_en: Prabesh manages various projects of the centre’s programs division implementing its grant projects, actualising its products and leading partnership activities for different government and international grant programs. He additionally coordinates interconnected efforts, manages shared resources and ensures the collective impact by forging new partnerships across multiple interest groups in Nepal.
fields.bio_np: प्रवेशले सेन्टरको कार्यक्रम विभागका विभिन्न परियोजनाहरूको व्यवस्थापन गर्दै अनुदान परियोजनाहरू कार्यान्वयन, संस्थागत उत्पादनहरूको प्रयोग तथा विभिन्न सरकारी एवं अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय अनुदान कार्यक्रमहरूका लागि साझेदारी गतिविधिको नेतृत्व गर्छन्। उनले अन्तरसम्बन्धित प्रयासहरूको समन्वय र साझा स्रोतहरूको व्यवस्थापन गर्छन् भने नेपालका विभिन्न सरोकारवाला समूहहरूसँग नयाँ साझेदारी निर्माणमार्फत सामूहिक प्रभाव सुनिश्चित गर्छन्।

fields.bio_en: Sankalpa manages the Programs Division of the centre implementing its grant projects, deploying its products and leading engagement activities for various stakeholders of the Province Cell. He additionally coordinates interconnected efforts, manages shared resources and ensures the collective impact through the centre’s social media presence.
fields.bio_np: संकल्प बरालले केन्द्रको कार्यक्रम विभागको व्यवस्थापन गर्दै अनुदान परियोजनाहरू कार्यान्वयन, संस्थागत उत्पादनहरूको प्रयोग तथा प्रदेश कोषिकाका सरोकारवालासँग संलग्नता गतिविधिको नेतृत्व गर्छन्। उनी विभिन्न विभागबीच समन्वय, साझा स्रोत व्यवस्थापन तथा केन्द्रको सामाजिक सञ्जाल उपस्थितिमार्फत संस्थागत प्रभाव र पहुँच विस्तार सुनिश्चित गर्छन्।

fields.bio_en: Cimonika assists the general administration of the centre maintaining efficient record management, daily financial log ensuring resource optimization and central administrative coordination. She additionally participates in ICT integration in office administration and financial record management.
fields.bio_np: सिमोनिका घिमिरेले सेन्टरको सामान्य प्रशासनमा सहयोग गर्दै अभिलेख व्यवस्थापन, दैनिक वित्तीय अभिलेख तथा स्रोत–साधनको प्रभावकारी उपयोग सुनिश्चित गर्छिन्। साथै, उनी कार्यालय प्रशासन र वित्तीय प्रणालीमा सूचना तथा सञ्चार प्रविधि (ICT) एकीकरणका प्रयासमा सक्रिय रूपमा संलग्न हुन्छिन्।

fields.bio_en: Sujal assists the general administration of the centre enabling operational efficiency by operationalising procurement, maintaining supply chains and other such related activities. He also coordinates with several logistics partners, financial institutions and regulatory authorities.
fields.bio_np: सुजल गुरुङले खरिद प्रक्रिया सञ्चालन, आपूर्ति शृंखला व्यवस्थापन तथा सम्बन्धित प्रशासनिक कार्यमार्फत सेन्टरको सञ्चालन दक्षता अभिवृद्धि गर्छन्। उनी विभिन्न ढुवानी साझेदार, वित्तीय संस्था तथा नियामक निकायसँग आवश्यक समन्वयको जिम्मेवारी पनि सम्हाल्छन्।

fields.bio_en: She supports the Institution’s strategic and research initiatives by contributing to its impact agenda, ensuring the quality and relevance of institutional outputs, and assisting in research management and publications. She also co-manages development and strategy efforts, supports partnerships and fundraising initiatives, and represents the Institution in policy, academic, and stakeholder engagements.
fields.bio_np: उहाँ संस्थाको प्रभावमुखी तथा अनुसन्धानसम्बन्धी कार्यहरूमा योगदान पुर्‍याउँदै संस्थागत उत्पादनहरूको गुणस्तर र सान्दर्भिकता सुनिश्चित गर्न सहयोग गर्नुहुन्छ। साथै, विकास तथा रणनीति सम्बन्धी कार्य, साझेदारी तथा स्रोत परिचालनका पहलहरूमा सहकार्य गर्दै नीतिगत, शैक्षिक तथा सरोकारवालासँगका विभिन्न कार्यक्रममा संस्थाको प्रतिनिधित्व गर्नुहुन्छ।

fields.bio_en: Sohan Thapa participates in the production and management of various deliverables of PRC-Digital - the tech group that manages the various digital tools associated with one of three project divisions of the company: research, programs and communications. He assists in the development of ICT tools in Monitoring, Learning & Evaluation of project deliverables making efforts accessible, and measurable.
fields.bio_np: सोहन थापाले सेन्टरको वेबसाइट तथा अनुसन्धान, कार्यक्रम र सञ्चार विभागसँग सम्बन्धित डिजिटल उपकरणहरूको व्यवस्थापन गर्छन्। उनले अनुगमन, सिकाइ तथा मूल्यांकन (Monitoring, Learning & Evaluation - MLE) का लागि ICT उपकरण विकासमा सहयोग गर्दै परियोजना परिणामहरूलाई अन्तरक्रियात्मक, पहुँचयोग्य र मापनयोग्य बनाउने काम गर्छन्।

fields.bio_en: Divya assists in the implementation and management of various deliverables within the Programs & Communications division—the group responsible for executing grant projects, actualising products, and maintaining partnerships. She supports the coordination of shared resources and interconnected efforts across different government and international programs, helping ensure the collective impact of the centre’s initiatives across multiple interest groups in Nepal.
fields.bio_np: दिव्याले कार्यक्रम तथा सञ्चार विभाग अन्तर्गतका विभिन्न उपलब्धिहरूको कार्यान्वयन र व्यवस्थापनमा सहयोग पुर्‍याउँछिन्— जुन विभाग अनुदान आयोजनाहरूको सञ्चालन, उत्पादनहरूको बजारीकरण तथा प्रवर्द्धन, र साझेदारीहरू कायम राख्न जिम्मेवार छ। उनले विभिन्न सरकारी तथा अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय कार्यक्रमहरू बीच साझा स्रोतहरूको परिचालन र अन्तरसम्बन्धित प्रयासहरूको समन्वयमा सहयोग गर्दै नेपालका विभिन्न सरोकारवाला समूहहरूमा केन्द्रका प्रयासहरूको सामूहिक प्रभाव सुनिश्चित गर्न मद्दत गर्दछिन्।

The MYOP 2026-2030's central theme takes inspiration from the Constitution of Nepal (Preamble): ELIMINATING all forms of discrimination and oppression resulted from all feudalistic, autocratic, centralized, unitary, system of governance of the State.

Share” NAPI hopes to foster innovation through various skills based programs and research deliverables. NAPI is named for the rabbits that live in our office.
fields.description_np: नापी सीप शिक्षा, प्रविधि र स्थानीय समाधानहरूको अन्तरसम्बन्धमा अवस्थित छ। “मापन । सिक्ने । साझा” भन्ने ट्यागलाइनको साथ नापीले विभिन्न सीपमा आधारित कार्यक्रमहरू र वितरण योग्य अनुसन्धानहरू मार्फत नवप्रवर्तनलाई बढावा दिने लक्ष्य राख्छ। “नापी” हाम्रो कार्यालयमा बस्ने खरायोहरूको नामबाट राखिएको हो।

fields.details:
Program Description:

The YPG Alumni Symposium, held on March 18th and 19th, was a transformative gathering that brought together graduates of the YPG Fellowship Program. This two-day event served as an inclusive platform, uniting alumni, policymakers, experts, and wider community members for dynamic ideas, skills, and insights exchanges. Representing Gandaki, Koshi, and Karnali provinces, YPG Fellows joined distinguished guests including Members of the Provincial Assembly (MPAs), US Embassy Officials, and other relevant personalities.

Venue: Atithi Resort and Spa, Lakeside

Testimony: Video

fields.title: Elevate PRC: Advancing Institutional Impact
fields.details:
Objective:

Increasing Instituional Capacity

Output:

-Successfully completed ongoing Four projects of PRC at 100%.
- Produce standard research methodology and guidelines (1) for PRC’s research
standardization along with policy briefs (1), articles (5), and research papers (1),
Gandaki province Budget Analysis.
- Organize three Gandaki Leaders Circle (GLC), two consultative meetings, targeted two
engagement programs for policymakers, and provide two policy recommendation
papers as knowledge.
- Relocate to a larger office space with 50% more space, acquire 2 necessary office
equipment (Projector, television), and procure 2 essential paid software (Finance
keeping and G-suit)
- Create a minimum of 6 impactful content in terms of social media posts, articles, blogs,
and presentations, host (2) webinars, optimize the website SEO 50% better and
disseminate research findings through conference

Outcome:

- Enhance organizational visibility and credibility by renewing ongoing partnerships at a
75% retention rate from four ongoing partnerships and 2 more new partnerships
within 12 months. Strengthen PRC's reputation and credibility by achieving a 50%
alignment of outcomes across all ongoing projects.
- Raise awareness and understanding of key policy issues in Gandaki Province by
achieving 3 national and 6 local media mentions and policy discussions referencing
PRC& it's research work within the next 12 months.
- Influence at least one significant policy change within Gandaki Province or 2-4 times
citation of our input in the Gandaki parliamentary session within the next year.
- Improve operational efficiency by achieving a 20% reduction in equipment downtime
and a 25% decrease in project turnaround time which is currently a 20% project delay
on the overall timeline within the next 12 months
- Elevate PRC's thought leadership in policy discourse by achieving a 20% increase in the
number of online engagement metrics (likes, shares, comments) and a 10% increase in
website traffic and newsletter subscription within 12 months.

fields.summary: To promote yoth political participation and engagemnet  in public policymaking and the legislative process.
fields.details:
Objective:

To promote yoth political participation and engagemnet  in public policymaking and the legislative process. Through a research and legislative training program, yoth will support provincial parliamentarians in advancing informed, data driven, centered policy formulation

Activities:

The Pokhara Research Centre (PRC) will continue to implement the Pre-Professionals Parliamentary Support Program (PPSP) -- a year-long capacity-building program for 50 youth from Gandaki’s 11 districts. Youth aged 20-30 years currently enrolled in undergraduate or graduate programs or recent graduates are eligible to apply and the PRC will promote the opportunity widely through local media, newspapers, and online educational sites to ensure broad, diverse, and inclusive outreach. The initial participant screening process will involve submission of a detailed application and an in-person interview. The PRC will prioritize applicants with an interest in government, public policy, policymaking, and/or with a strong record of community engagement.

fields.title: CON@10 Exhibition : Nepal's Constitution, A Decade of Democracy
fields.description: A multi-stall interactive exhibition marking the tenth anniversary of Nepal's Constitution, tracing the constitution-making process through historical archives, multilingual displays, and comparative constitutional data across eleven thematic stalls, culminating in a petition for a Law Book Library in the Province Capital.
fields.reach: PRC, Gandaki Province Assembly, artists, government bureaucrats, province-level institutions, young professionals, tourists (94 participants)

fields.title: Gandaki Agriculture Hackathon
fields.description: A PRC initiative convening students, farmers, and private-sector actors to co-create tech-enabled policy solutions for agricultural commercialization and governance, culminating in a pitch event and post-event mentorship producing policy-ready proposals for the provincial government.
fields.reach: PRC, The Asia Foundation Nepal, Ministry of Agriculture, Land Management and Cooperatives, five academic partner institutions, students, farmers, agri-business owners

fields.title: Multi-Stakeholder Dialogue on Digital Entrepreneurship, Remote Work Ecosystem, and IT Infrastructure Development in Gandaki Province
fields.description: Co-organized by NYEF and PRC, this NOIS-framework dialogue examined barriers to Gandaki's digital economy and the stalled Pokhara IT Park, drawing government, industry, and academic input toward a forthcoming policy advocacy report.
fields.reach: PRC, NYEF Pokhara Chapter, UNDP, Government of Gandaki Province, Pokhara Metropolitan City, Nepal Rastra Bank, FNCCI, GTEVT, IT companies, academia, media (112 participants)

fields.title: International Women's Day Celebration — Women in Leadership & Entrepreneurship
fields.description: An interactive session at PRC's Fishtail Rooftop featuring women sharing their journeys through moderated experience-sharing, Q&A, and networking, celebrating women's leadership and resilience.
fields.reach: PRC, women entrepreneurs, KOPILA Nepal, Press Register, Pahilo Paila Nepal, young professionals (24 participants)

fields.title: FCDO Regional Workshop : Understanding Youth Mobilization Around September 2025 Events and Its Implications for Political Change in Nepal
fields.description: Commissioned by FCDO through PEI, with PRC as local logistics partner, this workshop examined why Gen Z-led mobilizations bypassed traditional intermediary structures through structured small-group discussions on institutional unaccountability and post-movement political dynamics.
fields.reach: PEI, FCDO, PRC, Pokhara Chamber of Commerce and Industry, regional civil society, youth/Gen Z civic actors (22 participants)

fields.title: Open Door Weekend (4-Day Combined Program)
fields.description: A flagship stakeholder engagement event combining static exhibits, dynamic dialogues, and digital outreach across four days: Ward 11 community inauguration, youth-focused sessions (social media debate, PAT orientation, Gen-Z policy dialogue), sector roundtables (trekking guides, tech professionals), and an inter-level women's leadership dialogue.
fields.reach: PRC, Ward 11 community, youth/Gen-Z civic actors, trekking guides, tech entrepreneurs and IT students, women MPAs and local women leaders

fields.title: Statistical Analysis of Province Assembly Events (PAE): A Dataset Approach - Stakeholder Consultation
fields.description: A closed-door roundtable bridging legislative data and academic interpretation, showcasing the PAE Dataset's methodology to postgraduate Economics students, with discussion on the dataset's governance implications and PRC's role as Gandaki's provincial think tank.
fields.reach: PRC, Prithvi Narayan Campus (Tribhuvan University), postgraduate MBS/MA Economics students, Gandaki Province Assembly

fields.title: Expert Consultation and Feedback Session on Knowledge-Based Transformation & Knowledge Economy
fields.description: Co-organized by PRC and GPTA, this consultation presented PRC's Knowledge Economy paper to government officials and academics, gathering feedback on the framework's feasibility ahead of finalization.
fields.reach: PRC, GPTA, Government of Gandaki Province officials, academicians, policy experts (30 participants)

fields.title: Province Assembly Traineeship (PAT) : Capacity Building Programme for Gandaki Provincial Assembly
fields.description: A capacity-building programme placed four trained youth research assistants with MPAs to strengthen accountability questioning, bill drafting, and evidence-based debate, marking the first time Assembly questions were prepared with dedicated research support.
fields.reach: Gandaki Province Assembly, PRC Province Cell, youth trainees/research assistants

fields.title: Pokhara Dialogue Series V1S1: Technology, Talent and Research in Nepa
fields.description: Er. Bikram Adhikari, an engineer and AI professional based in Silicon Valley, joined PRC for a conversation on brain drain, the gap between academia and the job market, and how AI is changing work. The PRC team also sought his feedback on the Province Information and Engagement Portal (PIPE), including its research design and a realistic six-month scope. The session ended with a proposal for a Pokhara Reading Group to encourage critical thinking and discussion

fields.title: Pokhara Dialogue Series V1S2: Strengthening Think Tanks and Provincial Governanc
fields.description: Dr. Kuldeep Niraula, a researcher and Fulbright scholar with experience in US government, NGO and think tank work, discussed how think tanks can build stakeholder relationships, choose research priorities and communicate with the public through simple, engaging narratives. The conversation also covered how to shift public perception of provincial government and what it will take to put constitutionally guaranteed provincial powers into practice

fields.title: The Cost of Politics
fields.description:
The Pokhara Research Centre (PRC), with the support of the Westminster Foundation for Democracy (WFD), organised a discussion on “The Cost of Politics,” drawing on findings from WFD’s research on the financial costs of political participation in Nepal at Hotel Batika, Pokhara.
The session featured a presentation by Mr. Dinesh Wagle, followed by reflections from Dr. Deepak Prakash Bhatt, former Member of Parliament, House of Representatives. Participants actively engaged in the discussion, sharing perspectives on the financial barriers to political participation, inclusive representation, and Nepal’s political and electoral processes.
fields.reach: WFD, Youth leaders, Political parties representative, Media (Samadhan and Yatrasamachar), PMC - Youth Council
